purpose: Registry-wide mobile WebGL2 runtime smoke audit with selected modern theme artwork, reaction and rotation checks.

environment.effectiveResolutionNote: Global render scale .5 applies through BaseTheme where supported; raw custom surfaces retain their authored Low buffer resolution. Per-theme actual canvas dimensions are recorded.

limits: Phone viewport, touch and mobile user-agent behavior are emulated on a Linux software GPU; this is not physical iOS or Android validation.
Reduced drawing-buffer resolution bounds software GPU cost and does not measure phone FPS, battery use or thermal behavior.
Smoke success means active rendered content, nonuniform raster and no shader/GL validation errors; it does not establish artwork parity by itself.
Selected High checks exercise normal piece-lock, line-clear and combo event paths, finite attributes and landscape rotation.
Native WebGPU artwork and compute performance were not tested in this environment.
